plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: case '<%= nextRelease.version %>' in 2.*) echo 'major ceiling ok: <%= nextRelease.version %>' ;; *) echo 'REFUSING to release <%= nextRelease.version %>. This package stays on the 2.x line. To cut a deliberate major, raise the ceiling in .releaserc.json in its own reviewed pull request.' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
